meta.name: basecamp-automation
meta.description: Automate Basecamp project management, to-dos, messages, people, and to-do list organization via Rube MCP (Composio). Always search tools first for current schemas.

copy.tagline: 自动管理 Basecamp 项目、待办、消息和人员
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果日常用 Basecamp 管理项目，想自动化重复操作。
copy.tagline_en: Automate Basecamp projects, to-dos, messages, and people
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Basecamp daily and want to automate repetitive tasks.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你管理 Basecamp 项目：创建待办清单和任务、发布消息、管理成员、用颜色分组整理待办事项。
howto.when: 当你要求操作 Basecamp 项目（如创建任务、发消息、加人）时触发。Claude 会先搜索可用工具，再执行对应步骤。

say.text: 帮我给项目“网站改版”创建一个待办清单，叫“首页设计”。
say.note: Claude 会查找项目并创建清单。

say.text: 在“首页设计”清单里加一个任务：完成首页原型，明天截止。
say.note: Claude 会添加任务并设置截止日期。

say.text: 把张三加到“网站改版”项目中。
say.note: Claude 会查找人员并授予项目访问权限。

howto.what_en: Claude can manage Basecamp projects: create to-do lists and tasks, post messages, manage people, and organize to-dos into color-coded groups.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to operate on Basecamp projects (e.g., create tasks, post messages, add people). Claude first searches for available tools, then executes the steps.

say_en.text: Create a to-do list called 'Homepage Design' in project 'Website Redesign'.
say_en.note: Claude will find the project and create the list.

say_en.text: Add a task to 'Homepage Design': complete homepage prototype, due tomorrow.
say_en.note: Claude will add the task with due date.

say_en.text: Add John to the 'Website Redesign' project.
say_en.note: Claude will find the person and grant access.
